children: New America Acquisition I entered into a new Administrative Services Agreement with Dominari Holdings to provide office space and administrative support for $20,000 per month, effective October 15, 2026. On the same day, the company terminated its prior administrative services arrangement with New America Sponsor I, originally signed December 3, 2025, under a Termination and Release Agreement. The new contract runs until the earlier of an initial business combination or liquidation and is intended to ensure operational continuity during the SPAC’s deal search.
